title: AU other points: a spend with no budget line, in a life with a plan, counts against Free to spend
story: Set up Mon 4 Jan 2027: the bank holds 300,000, of which Food 30,000 and Free to spend 50,000 (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier). Wed 6 Jan: a 5,000 spend typed with no line. Thu 7 Jan: 2,000 of food. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 50,000 (Free to spend at the opening, typed) - 5,000 (the spend with no line, 6 Jan) = 45,000

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.note: The lowest day is today: the pay of 25 Jan (250,000) is more than the new period's Food (30,000) and Free to spend (50,000) taken with it, and again on 25 Feb.
